source.note: The explanations below are based only on the screenshot contents captured in the referenced conversation. Repeated position- or location-specific screenshots are consolidated into one rule. Genuine source conflicts are retained as separate records.

metrics.name: GOAL
metrics.explanation: Points for scoring a goal depend on the player's actual tactical position in that match. The league's official evaluation determines that position.

metrics.name: PENALTY SAVED (GK)
metrics.explanation: Awarded when the goalkeeper actively saves a penalty during normal match play.
exclusions: A penalty that misses without active goalkeeper intervention does not qualify.

metrics.name: PENALTY SCORED
metrics.explanation: Awarded when a player scores a penalty during normal match play. The player's position is irrelevant.

metrics.name: ASSIST
metrics.explanation: The pass must reach the eventual goalscorer without contact from another player. The league's official evaluation is decisive.
exclusions: If an opponent touches the ball while the eventual scorer is dribbling or involved in a running duel, the preceding pass does not qualify.

metrics.name: PENALTY SAVED (PENALTY SHOOT-OUT)
metrics.explanation: Awarded when the goalkeeper actively saves a penalty in a penalty shoot-out.
exclusions: A penalty that simply misses does not qualify.
Post or crossbar metrics and other team-specific or player points are not additionally awarded during the shoot-out.

metrics.name: SECONDARY ASSIST
metrics.explanation: Awarded when a player creates such a strong situation for the eventual assister that only a simple pass to the goalscorer remains. A cross to the eventual assister in a dangerous area near goal can qualify if the later assist is not demanding.
exclusions: It does not qualify if the eventual assister must win a duel, win a running duel, or execute a demanding precise or well-timed pass.
Corners and free kicks are excluded.

metrics.name: PENALTY SCORED (PENALTY SHOOT-OUT)
metrics.explanation: Awarded for converting a penalty in a penalty shoot-out.
exclusions: Post or crossbar metrics and other team-specific or player points are not additionally awarded during the shoot-out.

metrics.name: PENALTY WON
metrics.explanation: Awarded when the player is fouled inside the penalty area and a penalty is given.
exclusions: Penalties awarded for handball are excluded.

metrics.name: OWN GOAL FORCED
metrics.explanation: Awarded when a player's pass or shot forces an opponent to put the ball into the opponent's own goal.

metrics.name: DEFLECTED ASSIST
metrics.explanation: Awarded when an intended pass to the eventual goalscorer is deflected but remains within the originally intended danger zone.

metrics.name: DEADLY PASS
metrics.explanation: A through ball or lofted pass that travels through or over the opponent's defensive line and puts a teammate into a one-on-one situation with the goalkeeper.
exclusions: Crosses are excluded.

metrics.name: REBOUND ASSIST
metrics.explanation: Awarded when the player's ball is blocked by a defender and a teammate scores the rebound.
conditions: No other player may touch the ball between the block and the goal.

metrics.name: WOODWORK ASSIST
metrics.explanation: Awarded when the player's shot hits the goal frame and rebounds directly to a teammate who scores.
conditions: No other player may touch the ball between the woodwork contact and the teammate receiving and scoring it.

metrics.name: BIG CHANCE CREATED
metrics.explanation: A pass that creates a clear scoring opportunity, described as either a one-on-one situation or a free shot on goal from the danger zone.

source_conflict.note: Another supplied screenshot shows the same metric at 0 points.

metrics.name: CLEARED ON THE LINE
metrics.explanation: A field player stops or deflects a shot on the goal line that otherwise would certainly have entered the goal on a direct trajectory.
conditions: It must be established that no other player could have intervened.

metrics.name: DIVE SAVE (GK)
metrics.explanation: The goalkeeper makes a diving or rushing save and parries the ball to the side.

metrics.name: BONUS: LAST MAN TACKLE
metrics.explanation: A bonus for a successful tackle when the tackler is the last defender between the opponent and the goal.
exclusions: The goalkeeper is not counted when deciding who is the last defender.

metrics.name: GAME WON
metrics.explanation: Awarded when the player's team wins and the player actively participated in the match.

metrics.name: BIG CHANCE SAVED (GK)
metrics.explanation: Awarded when the goalkeeper actively saves a shot classified as a big chance. Preventing a one-on-one situation always qualifies.
exclusions: Merely collecting or catching the ball without meaningful effort is excluded.

metrics.name: BALL COVERED CHALLENGED (GK)
metrics.explanation: The goalkeeper dives to collect the ball directly from an opponent's foot while the opponent is in the goalkeeper's immediate vicinity.

metrics.name: SHOT BLOCKED

variants.location: inside the penalty area, using the more specific 6-yard-box rule where applicable

metrics.explanation: An active and purposeful defensive movement that blocks an opponent's shot. The value depends on where the block occurs.

metrics.name: SHOT ON GOAL
metrics.explanation: A shot directed at the opponent's goal.

metrics.name: ACCURATE KEEPER-SWEEPER (GK)
metrics.explanation: The goalkeeper actively runs toward the ball and deflects or plays it, after which the goalkeeper's team retains possession.

metrics.name: BONUS: LONG RANGE
metrics.explanation: An additional bonus when a goal is scored from outside the penalty area.

metrics.name: POST
metrics.explanation: Despite the displayed label POST, the supplied explanation describes a shot that hits the crossbar without a deflection from an opponent.
metrics.source_note: The label and explanation discrepancy is preserved.

metrics.name: LEFT POST
metrics.explanation: A shot hits the left post without an opponent deflection.

metrics.name: RIGHT POST
metrics.explanation: A shot hits the right post without an opponent deflection.

metrics.name: DIVE CATCH (GK)
metrics.explanation: The goalkeeper rushes or dives and catches the ball rather than parrying it.

metrics.name: INTENTIONAL ASSIST
metrics.explanation: A bonus when the passer clearly intends the pass to immediately generate a shot on goal.

metrics.name: SHOT SAVED (GK)
metrics.explanation: The goalkeeper saves or blocks a shot taken from inside the penalty area.

metrics.name: SHOT ON TARGET (NARROW MISS)
metrics.explanation: A shot narrowly misses the goal.
conditions: The horizontal miss is at most 3.5% of pitch width; on a 68-metre-wide pitch this is 2.38 metres.
A shot over the goal qualifies if it passes less than 1 metre above the goal.

metrics.name: SHOT ON TARGET (BLOCKED)
metrics.explanation: A shot that would have been on target but is blocked by an opposing player.

metrics.name: CROSS INTERCEPTED (GK)
metrics.explanation: The goalkeeper catches a cross.

metrics.name: BALL INTERCEPTED
metrics.explanation: The player actively intervenes to win the ball and the player's team retains possession.
exclusions: Merely collecting a ball after an opponent pushes it too far ahead does not qualify.

metrics.name: PUNCHED BALL (GK)
metrics.explanation: The goalkeeper clears a high ball by punching or fisting it away.

metrics.name: DISTANCE SHOT SAVED (GK)
metrics.explanation: The goalkeeper holds or saves a shot taken from outside the penalty area.

metrics.name: STANDING SAVED (GK)
metrics.explanation: The goalkeeper deflects or saves the ball while remaining standing.

metrics.name: SHOT ASSIST
metrics.explanation: A pass reaches a teammate who subsequently takes a shot on goal.
conditions: The pass must reach the teammate without contact from an opponent.

metrics.name: CONTEST WON
metrics.explanation: The player actively beats an opponent and takes that opponent out of the play.
exclusions: Simply passing or running past an opponent does not qualify.

metrics.name: TACKLE WON
metrics.explanation: The player wins a direct contest for the ball when an opponent had possession before the duel or tackle.

metrics.name: STARTING 11
metrics.explanation: Awarded when the player is on the pitch at the start of the match.

metrics.name: TEAM GOAL
metrics.explanation: Awarded each time the player's team scores while the player is on the pitch.
exclusions: A player already substituted off receives no points for later team goals.

metrics.name: CLEAN SHEET
metrics.explanation: If the player's team concedes no goals in the match, the player earns the position-specific amount for every 10 minutes played and the same amount again for completing the full match.
exclusions: Penalty shoot-outs do not affect the clean-sheet assessment.

metrics.name: BALL COVERED UNCHALLENGED (GK)
metrics.explanation: The goalkeeper collects the ball without taking a risk, while an opponent is still close to the ball.
exclusions: Simply picking up a ball played into empty space does not qualify.

metrics.name: SHOT ON GOAL (FAR AWAY)
metrics.explanation: A shot misses outside the narrow-miss thresholds.
conditions: It misses by more than 3.5% of pitch width horizontally, or passes at least 1 metre above the goal.

metrics.name: CLEARED (IN THE BOX)
metrics.explanation: An active intervention inside the player's own penalty area when the opponent previously had possession and the action immediately ends the dangerous situation.

metrics.name: CROSS
metrics.explanation: An accurate cross that reaches a teammate. It may originate from a corner, set piece, or open play.

metrics.name: AERIAL WON
metrics.explanation: An aerial duel won with a header when the ball is at least shoulder height. Either both field players jump, or one jumps while the other actively makes the header difficult. A field-player-versus-goalkeeper contest also qualifies if the goalkeeper deflects the ball.

metrics.name: FOULED LAST THIRD
metrics.explanation: The player is fouled in the most attacking or final third of the pitch, measured from the fouled player's team's attacking perspective.

metrics.name: INTERCEPTION (IN THE BOX)
metrics.explanation: A defending player actively intercepts a pass between opposing players inside the defender's own penalty area.

metrics.name: CORNER WON
metrics.explanation: The player in possession performs an action that results in the player's team being awarded a corner.

metrics.name: CLEARED (OUTSIDE THE BOX)
metrics.explanation: An active intervention outside the player's own penalty area when the opponent previously had possession and the action terminates the immediate game situation.

metrics.name: CROSS BLOCKED
metrics.explanation: An active and intentional defensive action that blocks an opponent's attempted cross.

metrics.name: PASS FINAL THIRD
metrics.explanation: A successful pass ending in the opponent's final third.
exclusions: Crosses, throw-ins, and goalkeeper drops are excluded.

metrics.name: SUBBED ON
metrics.explanation: Awarded when a player enters the match as a substitute.

metrics.name: FORWARD ZONE PASS
metrics.explanation: A successful pass ending in the opponent's half.
exclusions: Crosses, throw-ins, and goalkeeper drops are excluded.

metrics.name: ACCURATE THROW (GK)
metrics.explanation: A goalkeeper throw or drop during open play that successfully reaches a teammate.

metrics.name: ACCURATE LONG BALL
metrics.explanation: A successful pass travelling more than 32 metres.
exclusions: Throw-ins, crosses, and goalkeeper drops are excluded.

metrics.name: CROSS BLOCKED AND POSSESSION
metrics.explanation: Awarded when a player retains or gains possession after blocking a cross.

metrics.name: INTERCEPTION (OUTSIDE THE BOX)
metrics.explanation: A defending player actively intercepts a pass between opposing players outside the defender's own penalty area.

metrics.name: PLAYED MINUTES BONUS
metrics.explanation: The player receives 1 point for every 10 minutes played, including extra time, plus 1 additional point for completing the entire playing time.

metrics.name: FOULED IN THE OPPONENT'S HALF
metrics.explanation: The player is fouled in the opposition half, measured from the fouled player's attacking perspective.

metrics.name: BIG CHANCE CREATED
metrics.explanation: A supplied screenshot lists BIG CHANCE CREATED at 0 points. No additional explanation was captured for this version.

source_conflict.note: Another supplied screenshot shows the same metric at +15 points with a clear-chance explanation.

metrics.name: AERIAL LOST
metrics.explanation: The player loses an aerial duel. The aerial-contest conditions match AERIAL WON: the ball is at least shoulder height, the stated jumping or challenge conditions apply, and the duel is resolved through a header. A field-player-versus-goalkeeper contest can qualify if the goalkeeper deflects the ball.

metrics.name: OVERRUN
metrics.explanation: While carrying the ball, the player pushes it too far ahead and consequently loses possession.

metrics.name: POSSESSION LOST
metrics.explanation: The player loses possession of the ball to an opponent.

metrics.name: FOUL
metrics.explanation: The player commits a foul.

metrics.name: HAND BALL
metrics.explanation: The player's handball is penalized.

metrics.name: CHALLENGE LOST
metrics.explanation: The player loses a one-on-one situation without making contact with the opponent, such as missing an attempted tackle and being dribbled past.

metrics.name: OFFSIDE
metrics.explanation: The player is actively offside when a teammate passes or shoots.

metrics.name: CROSS NOT CLAIMED (GK)
metrics.explanation: The goalkeeper attempts to catch a cross but fails, either missing the ball or allowing the cross to travel past.

metrics.name: DANGEROUS PLAY
metrics.explanation: A foul or action in which the player accepts the risk of injuring the opponent.

metrics.name: INCORRECT THROW-IN
metrics.explanation: The referee penalizes the player or team because the throw-in was performed incorrectly.

metrics.name: 6 SEC VIOLATION (GK)
metrics.explanation: The referee penalizes the goalkeeper for violating the six-second possession rule.

metrics.name: GOAL CONCEDED
metrics.explanation: Applied when the player's team concedes a goal while the player is on the pitch.
exclusions: A player already substituted off is not penalized for later goals.

metrics.name: YELLOW CARD
metrics.explanation: Applied when the referee gives the player a yellow card for the player's action.

metrics.name: BACK PASS FOUL (GK)
metrics.explanation: The goalkeeper is penalized for illegally handling or taking a deliberate back pass.

metrics.name: BIG CHANCE MISSED
metrics.explanation: The player fails to score from a clear scoring opportunity where a goal would normally be expected.

metrics.name: MISTAKE BEFORE SHOT
metrics.explanation: A player's mistake immediately leads to an opponent's shot on goal.

metrics.name: GAME LOST
metrics.explanation: Applied when the player's team loses and the player was on the pitch at any point during the match.

metrics.name: PENALTY MISSED (PENALTY SHOOT-OUT)
metrics.explanation: Any shoot-out penalty that is not scored qualifies, including one that misses, hits a post or crossbar, or is saved.
exclusions: Post or crossbar metrics and other team-specific or player points are not additionally awarded during the shoot-out.

metrics.name: MISTAKE BEFORE GOAL
metrics.explanation: An error considered causal for an opponent's goal. It can apply to any player on the pitch.
assessment_factors: how avoidable or reasonable the error was
whether the player's team had a realistic opportunity to correct or neutralize the error afterward

metrics.name: PENALTY CONCEDED
metrics.explanation: The player commits a foul inside the penalty area that results in a penalty kick.

metrics.name: 2ND YELLOW
metrics.explanation: The player receives a yellow-red card, meaning dismissal for a second yellow card, as punishment for the player's action.

metrics.name: PENALTY MISSED
metrics.explanation: A penalty during normal match play is not converted, including a shot that goes wide, hits the goal frame, is saved or held by the goalkeeper, or otherwise fails to result in a goal.

metrics.name: OWN GOAL
metrics.explanation: A defending player's action causally produces a goal against the player's own team. The action must involve relevant tactical or action intent affecting the ball, and the league's official evaluation is decisive.
exclusions: An action not actively aimed at playing or deflecting the ball is excluded.
An action that was not causal in changing the ball's trajectory into the goal is excluded.

metrics.name: RED CARD
metrics.explanation: Applied when the referee punishes the player's action with a straight red card.
